The CSV file ihdp_9.csv contains data obtained from the Infant Health and Development Program (IHDP). The study is designed to evaluate the effect of home visit from specialist doctors on the cognitive test scores of premature infants. The confounders x (x1-x25) correspond to collected measurements of the children and their mothers, including measurements on the child (birth weight, head circumference, weeks born preterm, birth order, first born, neonatal health index, sex, twin status), as well as behaviors engaged in during the pregnancy (smoked cigarettes, drank alcohol, took drugs) and measurements on the mother at the time she gave birth (age, marital status, educational attainment, whether she worked during pregnancy, whether she received prenatal care) and the site (8 total) in which the family resided at the start of the intervention. There are 6 continuous covariates and 19 binary covariates.

What is the Average treatment effect on the control of the dataset? Please round to the nearest hundredth.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
d=pd.read_csv('ihdp_9.csv')
X=sm.add_constant(d[[f'x{i}' for i in range(1,26)]].values)
t=d.treatment.values.astype(float); y=d.y.values
T=t==1; C=t==0
print("n treated",T.sum(),"controls",C.sum())
print("naive diff of means:", y[T].mean()-y[C].mean())

# OLS with treatment + covariates (ATE-style coefficient)
ols=sm.OLS(y,np.column_stack([X[:,0],t,X[:,1:]])).fit()
print("OLS coef on treatment:", ols.params[1], "se", ols.bse[1])

# Separate response surfaces (T-learner)
m1=sm.OLS(y[T],X[T]).fit()
m0=sm.OLS(y[C],X[C]).fit()
mu1c=m1.predict(X[C]); mu0c=m0.predict(X[C])
print("ATC T-learner: mean_C[mu1(x)-y] =", np.mean(mu1c-y[C]))
print("ATC T-learner: mean_C[mu1(x)-mu0(x)] =", np.mean(mu1c-mu0c))

# Propensity model
ps=sm.Logit(t,X).fit(disp=0).predict(X)
# Doubly robust ATC (Kennedy-style, using mu1 for imputed treated outcome among controls)
mu1=m1.predict(X); mu0=m0.predict(X)
n0=C.sum()
dr = (np.sum((1-t)*(mu1-y)) + np.sum((1-t)*(ps/(1-ps))*(y-mu0)) ) / n0
# alternative: Hajek-weighted
dr2 = np.sum((1-t)*(mu1-y)) / n0
print("ATC DR (AIPW-style):", dr)
print("ATC outcome-regression mean over controls:", dr2)
EOF
